item.title: Azerbaijan's SOCAR Marketing Department sees drop in export revenues for Jan. 2026
item.description: In January 2026, the export revenues of SOCAR's Marketing and Economic Operations Department took a hit. The revenue took a nosedive compared to the same month last year, as per the latest data from the "Export Review" by the Center for Analysis of Economic Reforms and Communication.
